style: Cinematic 3D illustration style like a prestige animated feature (soft volumetric lighting, rounded forms, rich textures, gentle bloom and glow on celestial light). Deep midnight blues and indigos with warm gold moonlight and teal accents. Whimsical sense of wonder and scale, not photoreal, not flat vector. No text, no typography, no logos, no watermarks, no UI, no book covers. If any living beings appear, use stylized animated-feature character design (expressive, soft, non-photoreal) — never photoreal humans. No purple neon AI-glow cliché.

atmosphere.prompt: Wide atmospheric hero backdrop for The Hidden Reality by Brian Greene: layered parallel worlds and branes shimmering behind a thin veil of our universe. Empty of photoreal people, soft UI background. {style}

cover.prompt: Vertical book-cover art for "The Hidden Reality". Central motif: a curtain of spacetime pulled aside to reveal hidden parallel realms; memorable, generous negative space. {style}

og.prompt: Wide social share illustration for The Hidden Reality: panoramic hidden multiverse layers in teal/gold; cinematic, no people, no text. {style}
